Aviance Capital Partners Llc bought 24,875 shares as the company’s stock rose 19.42% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 26,027 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.69M, up from 1,152 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aviance Capital Partners Llc who had been investing in Netflix Inc. for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $156.46B market cap company. (NASDAQ:NFLX) has risen 115.45% since June 2, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 102.88% the S&P500.
